edges.reason: mint gates execution on whiteList[msg.sender] / isStart and mints to msg.sender, so the caller directly influences the protected path.
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 entropy used to derive the random token id.
block.timestamp is used as entropy in _random, making token id selection miner-influenceable.
mint loops and calls _random to obtain each token id.
mint calls _safeMint, which performs the external onERC721Received callback while first_generation_tokenIds and nonce are being updated.
onERC721Received re-enters the caller contract during the mint loop before the loop completes.
mint routes part of msg.value to payInternal.
mint routes part of msg.value to payShare.
payInternal forwards ETH to TECH_ADDRESS and CREATOR_ADDRESS with low-level call{value:}.
payShare forwards ETH to TECH_ADDRESS, CREATOR_ADDRESS, SHARE_ADDRESS and address(this) with low-level calls.
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares owner() to _msgSender().
withdraw sends the full balance to the owner via transfer after the balance check.
mintOfOwner is restricted by onlyOwner.
setStart is restricted by onlyOwner.
setFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
addWhiteList is restricted by onlyOwner.
rmWhiteList is restricted by onlyOwner.
setBaseURI is restricted by onlyOwner.
fee is multiplied by _quantity to compute the required msg.value.
setFee writes the fee state variable.
isStart controls whether the public mint path executes.
whiteList mapping read decides whether msg.sender may mint before the sale starts.
first_generation_tokenIds.length is read and pushed to for stock and share-tier accounting.
gift_generation_tokenIds length is checked and pushed in mintOfOwner.
indices array is read and written to avoid duplicate random ids.
nonce is used as entropy and incremented in _random.
baseURI is returned by the _baseURI override.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
_quantity drives stock checks and the fee multiplication.
ids array is filled with minted token ids and returned.
total-derived value flows into payInternal.
creator amount is forwarded to payInternal.
newTotal is forwarded to payShare.
constructor _fee is assigned to the fee state variable.
payInternal total parameter is split into tech/creator.
computed tech amount is sent via the payInternal low-level call.
computed creator amount is sent via the payInternal low-level call.
payShare total parameter is split into four portions.
tech amount sent in payShare.
creator amount sent in payShare.
share amount sent in payShare.
project residual sent to address(this) in payShare.
_to is the recipient of the owner mint.
_tokenId is range-checked and minted in mintOfOwner.
_start is written to isStart.
_fee is written to fee.
_addr entries set whiteList true.
_addr entries set whiteList false.
_uri is written to baseURI.
totalSize derived from nonce bounds the modulo in _random.
index selected by the weak entropy determines the token id.
value returned by _random becomes the minted token id.
